fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Q3 adjusted EPS of $5.75 missed consensus of $5.94, and net revenues of $50.17 billion fell short of $52.21 billion guidance.
fields.summary_ko.1: Equity Markets revenue grew to $4.95 billion (+49% YoY), Investment Banking to $3.1 billion (+15% YoY), and Payments to $5.62 billion (+14% YoY), though Fixed Income declined -4%.
